name: Lyra
author: Project Lyra
description: The Lyra platform: the mod manager UI, zuxhook, nativeapp daemon, and its component mods (mods-tab, wifi-power, clock-date) all wrapped in a pretty bow.
changelog: Installing or updating the platform now writes the loader last, so an update interrupted partway leaves a device that still boots. Groundwork for installing Lyra from the Zune's own browser, with no PC.
